output.narrative:
The ecpm metric moved by -0.0095, driven primarily by fill_rate contributing 15.81 to the revenue delta of 18.6. 

Looking into the ecpm drop, the primary segment is category=finance, with an explanatory power of 1.031 and a lift of 12.16. Within category=finance, the issue is further concentrated in ad_format=video, backed by an explanatory power of 0.994 and a lift of 4.92. 

Other dimensions such as ad_format=banner (lift -0.15) and category=gaming (lift -0.14) were checked and ruled out as they lacked meaningful explanatory power.
